_why: NIGHT70's slate (FORGE70, 2026-10-25; GG: 'can we use the same 2 methods to prompt another 8 hour overnight prompt'). Seven slices: Z1-Z3 (M3 on 20 seeds with the burst, the throw chart and the falls, the committed pilot), two launch rooms measured ALONE (kb3 R, v2 S; g8 parked: DECIDE69 Q-C has no honest payer under the walker rule), LV and PC (Builds/n70-play at the end). A doneWhen is written before any measurement and never loosened after one.
ROOM: an area card first (Research/2026-10-24-wave67/cards/<id>.md, <= 40 lines): the archetype (research.md section 2, one per room), the room's verb (one the verb pilot performs AND fires in this room with its loadout: the card cites the bearings' probe line), the lever that makes refusing the verb cost time, health or score, each piece and its job, the lint rules the shipped room fails and how the card fixes each, the aims for M1-M4; one card critic pass, its open items round 1's list; **a launch card also states (FORGE70, spike.md): the target launches per verb-aware run (at least the red's median + 2: kb3 red 4, v2 red 2) and how the room brings FRESH husk-shaped bodies (unshot, above the 30 hp launch bound) inside 5.5 m of the player (short sight lines, a corner or a door 6-10 m away: design-research.md R7), and where each throw ends (a wall 1-12 m past the punch spot on the approach line, or a pit whose near rim is 0.5-6.9 m out, 2.5-6.5 m long, no body within 1.1 m of the line before it: scout.md A, design-research.md R1-R4)**
the rebuilt room file carries `verb65` (equal to the slate's verb) and `line65` (the verb's line from the entry), never an `area67` block (the assembler refuses unknown fields)

a GATE needs M1-M4 and every GUARD held on one ALONE main-tree round on the passed tools, run as a job of the queue runner (`Tools/night/n70-runner.sh`; the job `bash Logs/n70/room-chain.sh <n> <id>`) (`L67=<L> ROOMS=<id> SLOTS=<id> bash Tools/night/n70-round.sh r<n>-<L>`, which Logs/n70/room-chain.sh runs: only this room new in its level, the others old, so it is measured against its red like for like: NIGHT68 saw one room file read 0.10 differently beside three other new rooms), skip v2 also on fresh seeds 21-30 (the GATE pack's fresh skip, or the alone round's pre-run it takes by --fresh; a pack whose fresh line names seed 11 is refused), the room file unchanged since that round, and that round read by a level review written at its named time (a fresh reviewer starts the moment the round ends: a round without one holds no GATE); a room without such a round is SHORT; **a GATE round starts after Z1-Z3 are each PASSed or SHORT (the tools at its start are the ones it is judged on: its slate-at-start.json); an earlier round is evidence only**

M1 AREA: `node Tools/night/n70-area.cjs --level <L> --dir <the round's folder> --touches <the round's verbs-skip.txt> <room>` passes every rule that applies (a rule with nothing to judge prints N/A): OPEN no open floor square larger than 12 x 12 m with no piece in it (gg-proxy's 'empty boxes'); P1 a plane 3.5 m or higher holds the last wave's ranged enemies (N/A with no ranged enemy); P4 every solid 1.75 m or taller does a job by the decoration checker; P5 at least half the walk line's samples in a ranged spawn's sight at 6-24 m and line65's share at least 0.3 lower, or line65 within 6 m of an enemy; P9 every plane 6 m or wider has at least 2 enemy climb routes with tops 8 m or more apart; P11 for a TOWER, GALLERY or SPLIT LEVEL card, every ranged spawn on a high node 2.5 m or more up and 12-24 m from the walk lane; P17 every ride wall 4 m or taller and 8 m or longer with the cyan strip, no non-ride wall in that band

M2 VERB: skip v2 on the room's verb, POOLED over seeds 1-20 (the median over the exercised seeds; the per-set ratios printed beside it), prints a ratio >= the room's mainBar (written from its red: max(1.25, red + 0.20)) with >= 14 of 20 seeds exercised, the refusal fired and the refused run NOT using the verb on any exercised seed; **STYLE: the verb-aware run's STYLE above DULL >= the refusal's - 5 points** (FORGE69: NIGHT68's min(refusal + 15, max(refusal, 95)) asked 91-94 % on levels 3 / 5 where the verb runs reach 79-82 %: unreachable; the new rule says the verb must not make the run duller; it is written here, before any measurement); a ride room whose ratio is in [mainBar, mainBar + 0.10) is UNSURE and does not PASS M2 (so a ride room needs 1.35); on the fresh seeds 21-30 the median ratio >= 1.25 and >= 7 of 10 exercised; **FORGE70: once Z3 (the committed pilot) PASSes, the verb-aware run is the FASTER of the plain verb-aware run and the committed one, as the refusal is the faster of the refused-in run and the walker (symmetric; written before any measurement); the reds and bars are then re-made on that tool before any GATE round**

M3: the room's verb pilot over 20 seeds (FORGE70 D-3, DECIDE69 Q-A; one seed was one sample: v2 s1b's crypt caught 15 of 20 probes where a1's seed 1 read FAIL): launch: `bash Tools/night/n70-throws.sh <the round's level> <id> <round>/throws-<id>.txt 20` (room-chain.sh runs it) prints `M3 candidates (D-3) N / 20`: a launched body that ends in a pit or lava, OR whose burst kills >= 2 (the flier included), on GREEN probes; PASS at N >= 10; ride: a kill from the wall (`n65verb ride --shoot`); parry: a returned glob kills a spitter; slide: the slide line's kill; pierce: >= 2 bodies

M4: every piece of the rebuilt room passes the decoration checker (its base the room file's first commit), and at least one collider piece was added with a job; a round's change counts only by a double-or-half (a piece added or removed, or one geometry number x2 / x0.5); **a rebuilt room keeps at most 25 % of the shipped room's pieces** (`node Tools/night/n70-patch-share.cjs --level <L> <id>`: geometry-equal boxes, ramps, pads and pits of Design/levels/n67/<L>/rooms-base/<id>.json: gg-proxy's #1 'the old room with a patch'; inside the slot's fixed rect and doors), and it keeps every verb and every pad / ride face the shipped room offered unless the card says what replaces it (nothing the player had is lost: air65's flights handed on)

GUARDS, no worse than the shipped room (its red; the ceilings in this slate: deathsAMax, deathsBMax, stallAMax): the walk bot (n46flow seeds 1-10 and 11-20) clears 10 / 10, deaths A / B and stall A at or under the ceilings; no room-check item fails that passed in the shipped room; air65's flights handed on; levelgen ERROR rows no more than the base level's own; the room's spawn never moved toward the verb's line
the blind SPOT (a fresh skygrind-spotter on the GATE pack's spot-A / spot-B) names the piece that serves the verb; a skygrind-critic PASS on the GATE round
